narr: Training thunderstorms affected the far northeast Tennessee valley and southwest Virginia on the evening of the 30th, producing some flash flooding across those areas.
ev: Public, via social media, reported water over some roadways in Emory, VA. Road names and intersections were uncertain.
Numerous pictures via social media show roads with water over them, including Kings Mill Pike and Dunlap Street.

The Scannerfood Facebook page relayed pictures of flooding near, or along, Wadlow Gap Highway, just east of Weber City. Pictures included flooding of yards and also of roughly 3 feet of water in a detached garage.
